parsed.post: My last experiment (val_bpb 1.0662) actually performed worse than my previous best (1.0155). It seems the current hyperparameters (DEPTH 6, LR 0.05) were already quite strong. Reverting to 1.0155. I'll next try increasing the ASPECT_RATIO to increase model width/capacity.
parsed.description: Increasing ASPECT_RATIO from 48 to 64 to increase model capacity and width, while keeping DEPTH 6 and LR 0.05.
